facts.fact: The Prime Minister launched the SYC@D land and cadastre system on 21 March 2025; the tax director general said the processes implemented let users request, process and receive online a cadastral extract, land allocation certificate and provisional and final transfer orders.
The tax director general said on 21 March 2025 that the cadastral and geographic databases have been integrated into SYC@D.

systems.owner: Directorate General of Taxes, Ministry of Economy and Finance
